content: A 17-year-old girl endured a traumatic experience on her birthday at Aastha Kunj Park. Following a trip to the Kalkaji Temple with a friend, they were confronted by three men posing as police officers, armed with knives. The survivor recounted her ordeal in detail, identifying her assailants by their nicknames and physical features. After the incident, her friend quickly contacted the police, ensuring that help arrived.

title: Russia to launch drone strike on Europe? CIA warns of 'potential' threat
content: The Central Intelligence Agency has alerted European countries, including Spain, France, and Italy, about a looming threat involving Russian drones potentially launched from commercial ships. These drones may be hidden within shipping containers and aimed at key infrastructures like airports and ports. While the intent is to cause disruption rather than large-scale damage, it heightens the necessity for vigilant monitoring of airspace and civilian maritime activities across the Mediterranean.

title: $30bn tariff cut, Iran and AI dialogue: Key points from Xi-Trump talks
content: Xi-Trump talks: tariff cuts, Iran, AI dialogue and more shape ties between the leaders of the world’s two largest economies . the visit focused on strengthening the relationship between the two sides reaching agreements and setting up mechanisms covering trade, investment, energy, drug trafficking and emerging technologies .
